context: Tatsuya stops at a roadside koban on his way home with too many vegetables. Takeda happens to be the officer.
purpose: small civic chance encounter — rural-urban kindness

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: すいません、ちょっと休憩、いいですか。
lines.en: Excuse me, can I take a small rest?
lines.style: Country gruff warm formal-rural civil-asking-warm, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: もちろん。長距離、お疲れさまです。
lines.en: Of course. Long distance — good work.
lines.style: Officer warm professional gentle generous-welcoming-warm, the soft real real-care audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: 田舎から、野菜運んできまして。これ、一つどうぞ。
lines.en: Brought veggies from the country. Here, take one.
lines.style: Country gruff warm sincere generous-rural-offering-warm, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: えっ、いいんですか。ありがとうございます。
lines.en: Eh, really? Thank you very much.
lines.style: Officer warm soft sincere surprised-touched-warm grateful, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: いつもお仕事、ありがとうな。元気でな。
lines.en: Always thanks for your work. Stay well.
lines.style: Country gruff warm sincere closing-civic-warm appreciating, the soft real real-warmth audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: こちらこそ。気を付けて、お帰りください。
lines.en: Same. Take care, head home safe.
lines.style: Officer warm gentle sincere closing-civic-warm farewell, the soft real real-care audible, gentle real warmth throughout delivery.
